name: [G-BOOK-04] Select one service and schedule it @regression — SKIPPED: the instant QA listing offers no add-on services
fullName: Guest · Instant booking [G-BOOK-04] Select one service and schedule it @regression — SKIPPED: the instant QA listing offers no add-on services
description:
Instant booking and checkout (Guest manual G3).

Runs on E2E_INSTANT_PROPERTY_ID ("Grand Demo 01", max 1 guest). Only
G-BOOK-01 pays; every booking it makes is cancelled again in afterAll.
Stays and the cancellation wizard have their own specs.
